summary: Evaxion A/S, a Danish biotech, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its quarterly business update and Q2 2026 financial results scheduled for August 20, 2026, with a conference call and webcast. This is a routine earnings announcement notice, not a special-situation event. The filing contains no transactional terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural details. It is purely an administrative notification of upcoming results and an investor call, with no M&A, capital markets, or strategic activity implicated. As such, it does not qualify as a special situation under any defined category.
